ServiceOwnership.description: Ownership of a service exposed through NeMo Fabric.

oneOf.description: NeMo Fabric created and owns the service lifecycle.
The caller owns the service and NeMo Fabric only owns its attachment.

description: Public identity and binding for one prepared or attached service.

adapter_id.description: Adapter that created or attached to the service.

connection.description: Sanitized connection summary. This never contains credential values.

ownership.description: Whether NeMo Fabric owns the underlying service.

service_binding.description: NeMo Fabric-owned opaque binding for this service handle.

service_id.description: Unique identifier for this process-local service lifecycle.

service_type.description: Stable service type returned by the adapter.

title: ServiceHandle
